verdict.rationale: Latham's own Book of Jargon – Emerging Companies glossary has entries for "83(b) Election", "Cliff Vesting" and "Vesting Schedule". This shows the firm's materials touch founder equity mechanics, but only at the level of glossary definitions. LathamDrive's incorporation document generator is first-party, but nothing shows it produces founder stock or vesting documents. Missing for 10: any coverage of equity splits among co-founders, in-depth guidance (beyond glossary entries) on setting vesting schedules and filing 83(b) elections, local equivalents to the 83(b) for non-US founders, evidence that the generator produces founder stock purchase or vesting agreements, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's own materials cover founder equity mechanics — vesting schedules, 83(b) elections or the local equivalent, and equity splits among co-founders — so day-zero ownership is set up right

citations.quote: Book of Jargon® – Emerging Companies is one in a series of practice area and industry-specific glossaries published by Latham & Watkins
